site.name: Gale crater, lower Mount Sharp boxwork

scenario.name: Gale default five science stops, three-flight campaign, no custom stops

energy_scenario_details.name: Late in the EVA: 5 h of suit left after 3 h of station work

scenario.extra_flights: None. Each flight selects the next unseen stretch of the replanned route.

definitions.hazard: Binary 8 m hazard cells, not a count of individual rocks. Unique cells and repeated visits are separate.
definitions.margin: energy left - cheapest known-hazard return cost - fixed reserve. Extra 20% means >=20% of INITIAL budget after that reserve.
definitions.traverse_share: Distance weighted, linearly interpolated between grid vertices; no stop dwell time.
definitions.energy_error: Uniform 0.7/1.0/1.3 multiplier on BOTH spent walking energy and remaining return cost; initial budget/reserve and the nominal scouted route stay fixed.
definitions.ring: Cells whose return fits remaining energy minus reserve, as displayed by the app. Area is grid cells x cell area, not a circular radius or a complete outbound-and-return reachability claim.
definitions.margin_audit: Directed reverse shortest paths recomputed using only discovered hazards; app hybrid return lookup reported separately.
definitions.scout: Shipped three-flight campaign with a re-plan after every flight. Spatial scans every 2 m plus endpoints; 30/60/120 fps must agree.

source_hash_convention: SHA256: raw binary; canonical sorted-key JSON; LF-normalized JS/MJS source

repeated_scout.stop_condition: At most 3 flights; stop early when the current route is already scanned. Re-plan after each flight.

rocks.method: NASA/JPL ROSCO + human positive review; no new network trained for R3

selected_proposal_agreement.meaning: Human acceptance among resolved frozen proposals; excludes uncertainty; not recall or held-out accuracy

terrain.architecture: Frozen ImageNet MobileNetV3-small features + trained 576x4 linear head; fixed unknown logit -100
terrain.limitation: Rover-photo classifier; not applied to orbital terrain. Curiosity test has zero big-rock examples. Perseverance transfer is poor.

buddy.limitation: Not trained, not evaluated, not a navigation policy or terrain prediction.

limitations: Simulated walk and scout on real NASA-derived terrain, not an astronaut or drone field trial.
The energy model is an estimate; +/-30% is a chosen stress test, not a measured confidence interval.
A hazard cell can be a DTM estimate or padded reviewed point. Neither cell count nor route crossings are individual-rock detection accuracy.
Only one fixed site, budget and stop set; this is not evidence of universal navigation safety.
Unknown hazards may remain. New route crossings of the full stored layer are audited separately from discovered hazards.
The app switches to globally scouted return costs only on scanned cells; the report exposes differences from an independently recomputed known-hazard return field.
Classifier accuracy is reported with its sample sizes and transfer result; the placeholder buddy has no accuracy result.
